description: This file defines a widget service for a calendar application, including a service class and a factory class to provide views for an Android app widget displaying calendar information with leave type icons.

classes.name: CalendarWidgetService
classes.description: A service providing a factory for creating remote views for a calendar widget in the Android application.

methods.name: onGetViewFactory
methods.description: Returns a RemoteViewsFactory to provide views for the widget.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon resource ID corresponding to a given LeaveType.

classes.name: CalendarWidgetFactory
classes.description: Factory class implementing RemoteViewsFactory to supply views for each position in the calendar widget.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items; currently zero.

methods.name: getViewAt
methods.description: Provides the RemoteViews for the specified position.

methods.name: getLoadingView
methods.description: Returns null, indicating default loading view.

methods.name: getViewTypeCount
methods.description: Returns the number of view types, which is 1.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns item ID; here, the position as a long.

methods.name: hasStableIds
methods.description: Indicates IDs are stable; returns true.
